vb_textbox.text: You need to make sure that you can follow the pattern of the numbers. You will often find that the progression goes up as you progress through the game, so for example if you choose the left hand side you will maybe start off with smaller numbers but you need to stick with that side and eventually the score will go up and up. You will then notice the opposite happening, so the numbers will get smaller. The strategy I used was to move to the other side when I hit a 0 score. So as soon as you score 0 on one side, move across to the other and keep hitting that side until you get a 0. Continue in that pattern until the end of the game to get a good score.
